name: Citronella
description: A woman in her forties, a veteran camper covered in mosquito bites and far too much bug spray, twitchy and scrappy, who sings garage rock.
build: A lean, wiry adult woman's build of ordinary proportions: narrow shoulders, a flat torso, long-ish arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Fair freckled skin with several big bold red bite welts on the cheeks and forehead, green eyes under thin light-brown brows, a narrow straight nose, and thin lips.
hair: Straight dishwater-blonde hair to the shoulders, mostly hidden under a wide khaki canvas bucket hat pulled low.
outfit: A khaki canvas bucket hat; a long-sleeved sage-green fishing shirt with two big chest pockets, sleeves rolled to the forearm; cargo shorts in olive with big side pockets; wool hiking socks in grey folded at the ankle; chunky brown hiking boots. Bold red bite welts on the bare forearms and shins. Both hands bare.
performance_style: Twitchy and alert: feet hip-width apart, knees loose, weight shifting. The character-right hand scratching the outer character-right thigh with fingers visible, the character-left hand open and empty at her side. Head cocked to one side, a wary squint.
location: The edge of a suburban backyard at dusk: lawn running to the bottom of the frame, three tall bamboo tiki torches and a yellow citronella candle bucket burning, a camping tent pitched by the fence, string lights and a lawn chair behind.
recognition_cues: a wide khaki canvas bucket hat pulled low
big bold red bite welts on face, forearms and shins
a sage-green fishing shirt with big chest pockets
avoid: a spray can in the key art
a green mist of bug spray

sing.intent: Garage-rock vocal loop: hunch and stomp, hold the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, slap the character-left open hand at a bite on the neck, then shake out and return to the alert stance. The mouth visibly opens wide and changes shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A mosquito whine by the ear: she jerks the head aside and swats the air with the character-left open hand, then settles back. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: pull the bucket hat brim down with both hands and hunch, holding a wary stance. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stomp in swatting the air with both open hands, then settle into the alert stance.
